notes.title: Giant Life - Release!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868207/00071bfdf1371b6f57fd59dd9f86c132b4b5cd11.gif[/img]
Well hello guys!
Today we are releasing the version 1.0 of Giant Life, a VR physic puzzle game.
Play as an angry giant through a virtual reality journey, exploring the realm, destroying settlements and frightening its inhabitants.

[h1][b]Main features:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] 5 special throwable projectiles.
[*] 22 unique levels.
[*] More than 50 destructible structures.
[*] Finger tracking for Valve Index, HTC Vive and Oculus rift controllers.
[*] Vikings, Knights and Pirates.
[*] Cute low poly graphics.
[/list]

[h1][b]Suggestions:[/b][/h1]
We hope you guys enjoy the game, and if you have any suggestions leave them in the suggestion section in the community hub:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1081250/discussions/2/

[h1][b]Bug reports[/b][/h1]
If you find any bugs feel free to report them in the community hub section.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1081250/discussions/0/

[h1][b]Discord[/b][/h1]
Come gather around a Giant Life! We'll be having weekly contest and giveaways!
[url=https://discord.gg/FF6dxzC]Join us on Discord![/url]

notes.title: Giant Life: The final countdown + Pre-Release Giveaways!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868207/5930b08d579f88c1d0d63c22805f5a3dbfe8d6a3.gif[/img]
Hello there guys!
We are very happy to announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1081250/Giant_Life/?curator_clanid=34868207]Giant Life[/url] is now officially out of beta.
Now we are on the final countdown until release: [b]June 7th.[/b]

[h1][b]Also we have a special announcement to make:[/b][/h1]
During the course of the week we will be selecting players that comment and like this post, and they will receive a free copy of the game for testing purposses!

Start smashing that [b]like[/b] button and [b]comment[/b] bellow! ːcamperː

[b]The Patagoniart Team.[/b]

notes.title: UPDATE - 1.05
notes.notes:
Well guys, we've been working hard this past week on changing game mechanics and most of all improving the multiplayer. Without further rambling here are the patch notes:

[h1] Vecitas Beta - 1.05[/h1]
[list]
[*]Changed completely the multiplayer p2p protocol. We're now relaying on SteamMatchmaking. 
[*]Added help UI in Singleplayer mode for those who were a bit confused about the goal of singleplayer.
[*]Corrected minor bugs.
[*]Corrected minor glitches on interfaces.
[*]Corrected glitches on ingame.
[/list]

We hope you guys enjoy the patch, and if you find any bugs report them in the "Bug Report" section.

The Patagoniart Team

notes.title: UPDATE - 1.02
notes.notes:
Well guys, we've been working hard this past week on fixing bugs, tweaking game mechanics and adding features to the game. Without further rambling here are the patch notes:

[h1] Vecitas Beta - 1.02[/h1]
[list]
[*]Optimized the multiplayer sendratio to adjust the positions of players in game.
[*]Corrected bug that made the singleplayer ships die while having gravitational power.
[*]Corrected bug that spawned enemy debuffs out of place.
[*]Added optimizations for lower CPUs. Change the quality in the main menu (Options), to play the game smoothly according to your hardware.
[*]Balanced the multiplayers plasma points spawns.
[/list]

We hope you guys enjoy the patch, and if you find any bugs report them in the "Bug Report" section.

[b]The Patagoniart Team[/b]
